issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'מַעְשַׂי' (Maasai), but the Chinese renders '瑪西雅伊' which appears to be a conflation/alteration of the name; the correct transliteration should be '瑪西' or '瑪賽'.
The Hebrew 'בֶּן מְשֻׁלָּם' means 'son of Meshullam', but the Chinese renders '梅書蘭姆人的兒子' adding '人' (people/person) which is not in the Hebrew and changes the meaning to 'son of the Meshullamite'.
